episodes.title: The first scientific test

episodes.disclaimer: Exploratory retrospective backtest complete. No incremental signal claimed. Clinical validation not started.
hook: TWO TEST SUBJECTS. NO SIGNAL CLAIMED.
episodes.thesis: LOWER ERROR THAN PERSISTENCE. TWO TEST SUBJECTS. NO SIGNAL CLAIMED.
episodes.conclusion: A smaller error is not a scientific claim when the held-out test is only two subjects.

captions.text: First exploratory retrospective backtest is complete.
Persistence MAE 1.425. Learned MAE 0.524. Test: 2 subjects / 2 pairs.
No incremental signal claimed. Clinical validation not started.
A smaller error is not a claim when the test is two subjects.
